questions.stem: Memo on the boundary wall: the alignment is x = t^2 - 6t and y = 3t for 0 <= t <= 8. Find the smallest value of x and the parameter at which it occurs.

options.text: The smallest x is -9, attained at t = 0, where the wall begins
options.misconception: attributes the minimum to the start of the range

options.text: The smallest x is -9, attained at t = 3, where dx/dt = 2t - 6 changes from negative to positive
The smallest x is 0, attained at t = 6, where the coordinate returns to zero
options.misconception: treats a zero of the coordinate as its minimum

options.text: The smallest x is 16, attained at t = 8, the end of the alignment
options.misconception: attributes the minimum to the endpoint of the range

questions.explanation: Setting dx/dt = 2t - 6 equal to zero gives t = 3, where the rate changes from negative to positive, so it is a minimum. Evaluating gives x = 9 - 18 = -9, which is smaller than either endpoint value.
questions.hint: Find the critical point and test it.
